'''Twi'lek liquor''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. It was very potent and would cause immediate intoxication if consumed too fast. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] were known to enjoy the [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]].
